policy: A source migration absent from the authenticated provider migration ledger must be explicitly pending. Provider-applied versions belong in remote-migrations.json. A ledger entry alone does not prove that the migration's intended behavior has been independently verified.

pending.reason: Creates graphify_ai_enabled=false by default. Graphify query and ingestion remain held until privacy, explicit AI personalization and sensitive-data consent, and per-member cost controls are approved.
Adds service-role-only profile-weighted rolling per-member AI request quotas using the existing rate_limits table. This is a request-budget control, not a monetary cost estimate.
